name: NvM
description: Configuration of the NvM (NvRam Manager) module.

children.name: NvMBlockDescriptor
children.description: Container for a management structure to configure the composition of a given NVRAM Block Management Type. Its multiplicity describes the number of configured NVRAM blocks, one block is required to be configured. The NVRAM block descriptors are condensed in the NVRAM block descriptor table.

children.name: NvMBlockCrcType
children.description: Defines CRC data width for the NVRAM block. Default: NVM_CRC16, i.e. CRC16 will be used if NVM_BLOCK_USE_CRC==true

metadata.LITERALS: NVM_CRC16 AUTOSAR_ECUC NVM_CRC32 AUTOSAR_ECUC NVM_CRC8 AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: NvMBlockHeaderInclude
children.description: Defines the header file where the owner of the NVRAM block has the declarations of the permanent RAM data block, ROM data block (if configured) and the callback function prototype for each configured callback. If no permanent RAM block, ROM block or callback functions are configured then this configuration parameter shall be ignored.

children.name: NvMBlockJobPriority
children.description: Defines the job priority for a NVRAM block (0 = Immediate priority).

children.name: NvMBlockManagementType
children.description: Defines the block management type for the NVRAM block.[NVM137]

metadata.LITERALS: NVM_BLOCK_DATASET AUTOSAR_ECUC NVM_BLOCK_NATIVE AUTOSAR_ECUC NVM_BLOCK_REDUNDANT AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: NvMBlockUseAutoValidation
children.description: Defines whether the RAM Block shall be auto validated during shutdown phase.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: if auto validation mechanism is used, false: otherwise

children.name: NvMBlockUseCRCCompMechanism
children.description: Defines whether the CRC of the RAM Block shall be compared during a write job with the CRC which was calculated during the last successful read or write job.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: if compare mechanism is used, false: otherwise

children.name: NvMBlockUseCrc
children.description: Defines CRC usage for the NVRAM block, i.e. memory space for CRC is reserved in RAM and NV memory.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: CRC will be used for this NVRAM block. false: CRC will not be used for this NVRAM block.

children.name: NvMBlockUseSetRamBlockStatus
children.description: Defines if NvMSetRamBlockStatusApi shall be used for this block or not.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Note: If NvMSetRamBlockStatusApi is disabled this configuration parameter shall be ignored. true: calling of NvMSetRamBlockStatus for this RAM block shall set the status of the RAM block. false: calling of NvMSetRamBlockStatus for this RAM block shall be ignored.

children.name: NvMBlockUseSyncMechanism
children.description: Defines whether an explicit synchronization mechanism with a RAM mirror and callback routines for transferring data to and from NvM module's RAM mirror is used for NV block. true if synchronization mechanism is used, false otherwise.

children.name: NvMBlockWriteProt
children.description: Defines an initial write protection of the NV block

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: Initial block write protection is enabled. false: Initial block write protection is disabled.

children.name: NvMBswMBlockStatusInformation
children.description: This parameter specifies whether BswM is informed about the current status of the specified block.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: True: Call BswM_NvM_CurrentBlockMode on changes False: Don’t inform BswM at all

children.name: NvMCalcRamBlockCrc
children.description: Defines CRC (re)calculation for the permanent RAM block or NVRAM blocks which are configured to use explicit synchronization mechanism.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: CRC will be (re)calculated for this permanent RAM block. false: CRC will not be (re)calculated for this permanent RAM block.

children.name: NvMInitBlockCallback
children.description: Entry address of a block specific callback routine which shall be called if no ROM data is available for initialization of the NVRAM block.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: If not configured, no specific callback routine shall be called for initialization of the NVRAM block with default data.

children.name: NvMMaxNumOfReadRetries
children.description: Defines the maximum number of read retries.

children.name: NvMMaxNumOfWriteRetries
children.description: Defines the maximum number of write retries for a NVRAM block with [ECUC_NvM_00061]. Regardless of configuration a consistency check (and maybe write retries) are always forced for each block which is processed by the request NvM_WriteAll and NvM_WriteBlock.

children.name: NvMNvBlockBaseNumber
children.description: Configuration parameter to perform the link between the NVM_NVRAM_BLOCK_IDENTIFIER used by the SW-Cs and the FEE_BLOCK_NUMBER expected by the memory abstraction modules. The parameter value equals the FEE_BLOCK_NUMBER or EA_BLOCK_NUMBER shifted to the right by NvMDatasetSelectionBits bits. (ref. to chapter 7.1.2.1).

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Calculation Formula: value = TargetBlockReference.[Ea/Fee]BlockConfiguration.[Ea/Fee]BlockNumber >> NvMDatasetSelectionBits

children.name: NvMNvBlockLength
children.description: Defines the NV block data length in bytes.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Note: The implementer can add the attribute 'withAuto' to the parameter definition which indicates that the length can be calculated by the generator automatically (e.g. by using the sizeof operator). When 'withAuto' is set to 'true' for this parameter definition the 'isAutoValue' can be set to 'true'. If 'isAutoValue' is set to 'true' the actual value will not be considered during ECU Configuration but will be (re-)calculated by the code generator and stored in the value attribute afterwards.

children.name: NvMNvBlockNum
children.description: Defines the number of multiple NV blocks in a contiguous area according to the given block management type.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: 1-255 For NVRAM blocks to be configured of block management type NVM_BLOCK_DATASET. The actual range is limited according to SWS_NvM_00444. 1 For NVRAM blocks to be configured of block management type NVM_BLOCK_NATIVE 2 For NVRAM blocks to be configured of block management type NVM_BLOCK_REDUNDANT

children.name: NvMNvramBlockIdentifier
children.description: Identification of a NVRAM block via a unique block identifier.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Implementation Type: NvM_BlockIdType. min = 1 max = 2^(16- NVM_DATASET_SELECTION_BITS)-1 Reserved NVRAM block IDs: 0 -> to derive multi block request results via NvM_GetErrorStatus 1 -> redundant NVRAM block which holds the configuration ID (generation tool should check that this block is correctly configured from type,CRC and size point of view)

children.name: NvMNvramDeviceId
children.description: Defines the NVRAM device ID where the NVRAM block is located.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Calculation Formula: value = TargetBlockReference.[Ea/Fee]BlockConfiguration.[Ea/Fee]DeviceIndex

children.name: NvMRamBlockDataAddress
children.description: Defines the start address of the RAM block data.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: If this is not configured, no permanent RAM data block is available for the selected block management type.

children.name: NvMReadRamBlockFromNvCallback
children.description: Entry address of a block specific callback routine which shall be called in order to let the application copy data from the NvM module's mirror to RAM block.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Implementation type: Std_ReturnType E_OK: copy was successful E_NOT_OK: copy was not successful, callback routine to be called again

children.name: NvMResistantToChangedSw
children.description: Defines whether a NVRAM block shall be treated resistant to configuration changes or not. If there is no default data available at configuration time then the application shall be responsible for providing the default initialization data. In this case the application has to use NvM_GetErrorStatus()to be able to distinguish between first initialization and corrupted data.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: NVRAM block is resistant to changed software. false: NVRAM block is not resistant to changed software.

children.name: NvMRomBlockDataAddress
children.description: Defines the start address of the ROM block data.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: If not configured, no ROM block is available for the selected block management type.

children.name: NvMRomBlockNum
children.description: Defines the number of multiple ROM blocks in a contiguous area according to the given block management type.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: 0-254 For NVRAM blocks to be configured of block management type NVM_BLOCK_DATASET. The actual range is limited according to SWS_NvM_00444. 0-1 For NVRAM blocks to be configured of block management type NVM_BLOCK_NATIVE 0-1 For NVRAM blocks to be configured of block management type NVM_BLOCK_REDUNDANT

children.name: NvMSelectBlockForReadAll
children.description: Defines whether a NVRAM block shall be processed during NvM_ReadAll or not. This configuration parameter has only influence on those NVRAM blocks which are configured to have a permanent RAM block or which are configured to use explicit synchronization mechanism.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: NVRAM block shall be processed by NvM_ReadAll false: NVRAM block shall not be processed by NvM_ReadAll

children.name: NvMSelectBlockForWriteAll
children.description: Defines whether a NVRAM block shall be processed during NvM_WriteAll or not. This configuration parameter has only influence on those NVRAM blocks which are configured to have a permanent RAM block or which are configured to use explicit synchronization mechanism.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: NVRAM block shall be processed by NvM_WriteAll false: NVRAM block shall not be processed by NvM_WriteAll

children.name: NvMSingleBlockCallback
children.description: Entry address of the block specific callback routine which shall be invoked on termination of each asynchronous single block request [NVM113].

children.name: NvMStaticBlockIDCheck
children.description: Defines if the Static Block ID check is enabled.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: false: Static Block ID check is disabled. true: Static Block ID check is enabled.

children.name: NvMWriteBlockOnce
children.description: Defines write protection after first write. The NVRAM manager sets the write protection bit after the NV block was written the first time. This means that some of the NV blocks in the NVRAM should never be erased nor be replaced with the default ROM data after first initialization. [NVM276].

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: Defines write protection after first write is enabled. false: Defines write protection after first write is disabled.

children.name: NvMWriteRamBlockToNvCallback
children.description: Entry address of a block specific callback routine which shall be called in order to let the application copy data from RAM block to NvM module's mirror.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Implementation type: Std_ReturnType E_OK: copy was successful E_NOT_OK: copy was not successful, callback routine to be called again

children.name: NvMWriteVerification
children.description: Defines if Write Verification is enabled.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: false: Write verification is disabled. true: Write Verification is enabled.

children.name: NvMWriteVerificationDataSize
children.description: Defines the number of bytes to compare in each step when comparing the content of a RAM Block and a block read back.

children.name: NvMTargetBlockReference
children.description: This parameter is just a container for the parameters for EA and FEE

children.name: NvMEaRef
children.description: EEPROM Abstraction

children.name: NvMNameOfEaBlock
children.description: reference to EaBlock

children.name: NvMFeeRef
children.description: Flash EEPROM Emulation

children.name: NvMNameOfFeeBlock
children.description: reference to FeeBlock

children.name: NvMCommon
children.description: Container for common configuration options.

children.name: NvMApiConfigClass
children.description: Preprocessor switch to enable some API calls which are related to NVM API configuration classes.

metadata.LITERALS: NVM_API_CONFIG_CLASS_1 AUTOSAR_ECUC NVM_API_CONFIG_CLASS_2 AUTOSAR_ECUC NVM_API_CONFIG_CLASS_3 AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: NvMBswMMultiBlockJobStatusInformation
children.description: This parameter specifies whether BswM is informed about the current status of the multiblock job.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: True: call BswM_NvM_CurrentJobMode if ReadAll and WriteAll are started, finished, canceled False: do not inform BswM at all

children.name: NvMCompiledConfigId
children.description: Configuration ID regarding the NV memory layout. This configuration ID shall be published as e.g. a SW-C shall have the possibility to write it to NV memory.

children.name: NvMCrcNumOfBytes
children.description: If CRC is configured for at least one NVRAM block, this parameter defines the maximum number of bytes which shall be processed within one cycle of job processing.

children.name: NvMDatasetSelectionBits
children.description: Defines the number of least significant bits which shall be used to address a certain dataset of a NVRAM block within the interface to the memory hardware abstraction.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: 0..8: Number of bits which are used for dataset or redundant block addressing. 0: No dataset or redundant NVRAM blocks are configured at all, no selection bits required. 1: In case of redundant NVRAM blocks are configured, but no dataset NVRAM blocks.

children.name: NvMDevErrorDetect
children.description: Switches the Default Error Tracer (Det) detection and notification ON or OFF.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: * true: enabled (ON). * false: disabled (OFF).

children.name: NvMDrvModeSwitch
children.description: Preprocessor switch to enable switching memory drivers to fast mode during performing NvM_ReadAll and NvM_WriteAll

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: Fast mode enabled. false: Fast mode disabled.

children.name: NvMDynamicConfiguration
children.description: Preprocessor switch to enable the dynamic configuration management handling by the NvM_ReadAll request.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: Dynamic configuration management handling enabled. false: Dynamic configuration management handling disabled.

children.name: NvMJobPrioritization
children.description: Preprocessor switch to enable job prioritization handling

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: Job prioritization handling enabled. false: Job prioritization handling disabled.

children.name: NvMMainFunctionPeriod
children.description: The period between successive calls to the main function in seconds.

children.name: NvMMultiBlockCallback
children.description: Entry address of the common callback routine which shall be invoked on termination of each asynchronous multi block request

children.name: NvMPollingMode
children.description: Preprocessor switch to enable/disable the polling mode in the NVRAM Manager and at the same time disable/enable the callback functions useable by lower layers

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: Polling mode enabled, callback function usage disabled. false: Polling mode disabled, callback function usage enabled.

children.name: NvMRepeatMirrorOperations
children.description: Defines the number of retries to let the application copy data to or from the NvM module's mirror before postponing the current job.

children.name: NvMSetRamBlockStatusApi
children.description: Preprocessor switch to enable the API NvM_SetRamBlockStatus.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: API NvM_SetRamBlockStatus enabled. false: API NvM_SetRamBlockStatus disabled.

children.name: NvMSizeImmediateJobQueue
children.description: Defines the number of queue entries for the immediate priority job queue. If NVM_JOB_PRIORITIZATION is switched OFF this parameter shall be out of scope.

children.name: NvMSizeStandardJobQueue
children.description: Defines the number of queue entries for the standard job queue.

children.name: NvMVersionInfoApi
children.description: Pre-processor switch to enable / disable the API to read out the modules version information [NVM285], [NVM286].

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: Version info API enabled. false: Version info API disabled.

children.name: NvmDemEventParameterRefs
children.description: Container for the references to DemEventParameter elements which shall be invoked using the API Dem_ReportErrorStatus API in case the corresponding error occurs. The EventId is taken from the referenced DemEventParameter's DemEventId value. The standardized errors are provided in the container and can be extended by vendor specific error references.

children.name: NVM_E_HARDWARE
children.description: Reference to the DemEventParameter which shall be issued when the hardware error has occured.

children.name: NVM_E_INTEGRITY_FAILED
children.description: Reference to the DemEventParameter which shall be issued when the error "API request integrity failed" has occurred.

children.name: NVM_E_LOSS_OF_REDUNDANCY
children.description: Reference to the DemEventParameter which shall be issued when the error "loss of redundancy" has occurred.

children.name: NVM_E_QUEUE_OVERFLOW
children.description: Reference to the DemEventParameter which shall be issued when the error "NVRAM Managers job queue overflow" has occurred.

children.name: NVM_E_REQ_FAILED
children.description: Reference to the DemEventParameter which shall be issued when the error "API request failed" has occurred.

children.name: NVM_E_VERIFY_FAILED
children.description: Reference to the DemEventParameter which shall be issued when the error "Write Verification failed" has occurred.

children.name: NVM_E_WRITE_PROTECTED
children.description: Reference to the DemEventParameter which shall be issued when the error "write attempt to NVRAM block with write protection" has occurred.

children.name: NVM_E_WRONG_BLOCK_ID
children.description: Reference to the DemEventParameter which shall be issued when the error "Static Block ID check failed" has occurred.
